name: Brightness
author: João Pereira
description: Ambient-light auto brightness for every connected display, the Apple Studio Display, a laptop panel or a DDC/CI monitor, from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Brightness slider for the display this bar is on, with an Auto mode driven by an ambient light sensor: the display's own, else the laptop's, else any other; manual only without one. Shows only on displays the plugin drives.

schema.label: Adjust brightness automatically on newly connected displays
